### From TMRS-2019 Rate Letter (2023-03-17)

*From: TMRS-2019 Rate Letter (2023-03-17)*

- City of Schertz TMRS contribution rate for 2019 set at 16.16% (16.04% retirement + 0.12% Supplemental Death Benefit) [SOURCE: TMRS-2019 Rate Letter]
- City pension plan funded ratio improved from 73.2% (2016) to 74.7% (2017) [SOURCE: TMRS-2019 Rate Letter]
- TMRS plan has 322 active members, 98 retirees/beneficiaries, and 166 inactive members as of December 31, 2017 [SOURCE: TMRS-2019 Rate Letter]
- Unfunded pension liability of $16.7 million represents 94.9% of annual payroll [SOURCE: TMRS-2019 Rate Letter]
- Employee deposit rate is 7% with a 2-to-1 city matching ratio [SOURCE: TMRS-2019 Rate Letter]
- Retirement eligibility is age 60 with 5 years of service or 20 years of service at any age [SOURCE: TMRS-2019 Rate Letter]
- Plan provides 70% of CPI repeating annuity increases to retirees [SOURCE: TMRS-2019 Rate Letter]
- BAF crediting rate for 2017 was 13.05%, significantly higher than the 6.73% in 2016 [SOURCE: TMRS-2019 Rate Letter]
- Return on Actuarial Value of Assets was 6.96% in 2017, slightly above assumed 6.75% [SOURCE: TMRS-2019 Rate Letter]
- Vesting requires 5 years of service [SOURCE: TMRS-2019 Rate Letter]

### From TMRS-2020 Rate Letter (2023-03-17)

*From: TMRS-2020 Rate Letter (2023-03-17)*

- City of Schertz TMRS contribution rate for 2020 set at 15.92% (15.80% retirement + 0.12% supplemental death benefit) [SOURCE: TMRS-2020 Rate Letter]
- Pension funded ratio improved from 74.7% in 2017 to 76.3% in 2018 [SOURCE: TMRS-2020 Rate Letter]
- City has 328 active TMRS members, 111 retirees/beneficiaries, and 191 inactive members as of December 31, 2018 [SOURCE: TMRS-2020 Rate Letter]
- Unfunded pension liability is $17,029,372, equivalent to 90.1% of annual payroll [SOURCE: TMRS-2020 Rate Letter]
- Employee deposit rate is 7% with 2-to-1 city matching ratio [SOURCE: TMRS-2020 Rate Letter]
- Retirement eligibility is age 60 with 5 years of service, or 20 years of service at any age [SOURCE: TMRS-2020 Rate Letter]
- City provides supplemental death benefits to both active employees and retirees [SOURCE: TMRS-2020 Rate Letter]
- TMRS uses 6.75% assumed investment return and 3.0% assumed payroll growth [SOURCE: TMRS-2020 Rate Letter]
- Actuarial Value of Assets returned 6.39% in 2018, slightly below the 6.75% assumption [SOURCE: TMRS-2020 Rate Letter]
- UAAL is being amortized over 25 years under current funding policy [SOURCE: TMRS-2020 Rate Letter]

### From TMRS-2021 Rate Letter (2023-03-17)

*From: TMRS-2021 Rate Letter (2023-03-17)*

- City of Schertz TMRS contribution rate for 2021 increases to 16.43% (minimum phase-in) or 16.45% (full rate) from 15.92% in 2020 [SOURCE: TMRS-2021 Rate Letter]
- Schertz pension plan has 344 active members, 116 retirees/beneficiaries, and 209 inactive members as of December 31, 2019 [SOURCE: TMRS-2021 Rate Letter]
- City's pension funded ratio is 78.0% with $17.19 million unfunded actuarial accrued liability [SOURCE: TMRS-2021 Rate Letter]
- Pension fund had 6.87% return on actuarial value of assets during 2019 [SOURCE: TMRS-2021 Rate Letter]
- Employer normal cost rate is 10.86% and prior service rate is 5.46%, totaling 16.32% full retirement rate [SOURCE: TMRS-2021 Rate Letter]
- City employee deposit rate is 7% with 2-to-1 city matching ratio [SOURCE: TMRS-2021 Rate Letter]
- Vesting requires 5 years of service; retirement eligibility at age 60 with 5 years or 20 years of service regardless of age [SOURCE: TMRS-2021 Rate Letter]
- Plan provides 100% repeating transfers for updated service credit and 70% of CPI repeating annuity increases [SOURCE: TMRS-2021 Rate Letter]
- Supplemental death benefits provided to both active employees and retirees [SOURCE: TMRS-2021 Rate Letter]
- TMRS amended asset smoothing method by decreasing corridor limit from 15% to 12% around market value [SOURCE: TMRS-2021 Rate Letter]

### From TMRS-2023 Rate Letter (2023-03-17)

*From: TMRS-2023 Rate Letter (2023-03-17)*

- City of Schertz TMRS plan has 356 active members, 138 retirees and beneficiaries, and 267 inactive members as of December 31, 2021 [SOURCE: TMRS-2023 Rate Letter]
- The city's pension plan is 80.9% funded with a funded ratio based on actuarial value of assets [SOURCE: TMRS-2023 Rate Letter]
- City offers 2:1 matching ratio for employee pension contributions (city contributes $2 for every $1 employee contributes) [SOURCE: TMRS-2023 Rate Letter]
- Employee contribution rate is 7% of salary [SOURCE: TMRS-2023 Rate Letter]
- Retirement eligibility is age 60 with 5 years of service or 20 years of service at any age [SOURCE: TMRS-2023 Rate Letter]
- City provides both active employee and retiree supplemental death benefits [SOURCE: TMRS-2023 Rate Letter]
- Retiree cost of living adjustment is 70% of CPI on a repeating basis [SOURCE: TMRS-2023 Rate Letter]
- Vesting period is 5 years [SOURCE: TMRS-2023 Rate Letter]
- The BAF balance earned 12.26% return in 2021, significantly above the assumed 6.75% rate [SOURCE: TMRS-2023 Rate Letter]
- TMRS uses a 10-year smoothing method for asset valuations to reduce contribution rate volatility [SOURCE: TMRS-2023 Rate Letter]
